title: Hybrid UI illustration / Greeked text — Dark themes

location.series: IBM Design Language / alternate tab states
location.label: Dark themes

slide_intent: Tune textual detail to an illustration’s purpose, because readable UI content and implied text guide attention differently.
strategic_value: A consistent dark-theme greeking treatment can keep IBM product explanations recognizable without distracting readers with incidental wording.
demonstration: Two dark accordion examples sit side by side: the left uses gray bars and a blue bar to imply text, while the right retains labels, paragraph text and a link.
practical_value: Choose which text must remain readable and which can be reduced to bars at the illustration’s intended scale.

content_islands.name: Theme selector
content_islands.spec: Show Dark themes selected beside Light themes.

content_islands.name: Implied text
content_islands.spec: Place the simplified accordion at left, using different gray-bar weights and a blue interactive-text bar.

content_islands.name: Literal text
content_islands.spec: Place the readable accordion at right with an expanded section and explanatory paragraph.

ingredient.name: Dark-theme greeked type
ingredient.role: Preserve UI hierarchy while reducing incidental detail.
ingredient.application: Use Gray 70 rectangles for regular text, Gray 50 for semibold/bold and Blue 70 for interactive text; retain actual wording where it carries the concept.
ingredient.scope: Hybrid UI illustration text treatment. This is not permission to put the whole composition on a dark background; the page separately discourages dark-theme compositions.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying hybrid UI guidance says greeking removes irrelevant or illegible detail to keep attention on conceptual flow.
reference_purposes.Application: The paired accordion treatments demonstrate translating literal UI text into a simplified typographic representation.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The accompanying text assigns Gray 70 to regular greeked text, Gray 50 to stronger text and Blue 70 to interactive type in dark themes.
